note:
Malcolm, 2026-08-31: reduce the header banner height on /pages/shipping-returns (asked for alongside /pages/contact).

This hero carries NO image — it is a flat #1A1A1A band at overlay_opacity 100 — so unlike the contact banner there is no subject to crop and the height can simply come down. Measured before choosing a number: at 390px the box was 375px tall around 109px of type, leaving 133px of dead space above AND below. The new heights leave a comfortable 86px.

The theme's own `sm` ladder is 375 / 400 / 440 across `(pointer:fine)`, `min-width:700px` and `min-width:1400px`, so the override matches that ladder rather than inventing new breakpoints: 280 / 300 / 340. The desktop 340px lands within a pixel of what the contact banner now resolves to at 1512 (341px), so the two page headers read as the same object.

Scoped with `{{ section.id }}` in a liquid block per ADR-006, not a custom-html section — a hardcoded section id goes stale and a section class would catch any other image-with-text-overlay that later lands on this template.

The wrapper div the theme puts around a liquid block is hidden. It is a flex/grid child of the text stack, so leaving it visible adds a gap and pushes the heading off centre; the style inside still applies while its wrapper is display:none. This is the same guard the contact hero block already carries.

settings.liquid:
<style>
/* Claude Code, 2026-08-31 - shorter header banner for /pages/shipping-returns.

   No image in this hero, so there is no subject to crop and the box can simply
   come down. Matches the theme's own sm ladder of 375 / 400 / 440 rather than
   inventing breakpoints. Measured first: at 390px the old 375px box held 109px
   of type with 133px of dead space above and below it. */
#shopify-section-{{ section.id }} .content-over-media {
  --content-over-media-height: 280px;
}

@media screen and (min-width: 700px) {
  #shopify-section-{{ section.id }} .content-over-media {
    --content-over-media-height: 300px;
  }
}

@media screen and (min-width: 1400px) {
  #shopify-section-{{ section.id }} .content-over-media {
    --content-over-media-height: 340px;
  }
}

/* The theme wraps a liquid block in a plain div, which takes a gap in the text
   stack and pushes the heading off centre. The style inside still applies while
   its wrapper is display:none. */
#shopify-section-{{ section.id }} .prose > div:has(> style) { display: none; }
</style>
